shared_elements: upright carved stone slab with relief decoration
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both are upright stone slabs covered with low-relief imagery combining a standing human figure with profile zoomorphic/serpentine motifs and some circular or spiral forms. The biggest difference is compositional and stylistic: A is divided into rougher, more open horizontal registers with simple incised/geometric carving, while B is a dense, vertically organized, highly curvilinear scene centered on a richly detailed figure.
